headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.exit_budget
headlines.statement:
∀ (d t : ℕ),
  (1 - Math115.PhysicalRationalKernel.proposalRat d / 2) ^ Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.attempts d t +
      ↑(Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.attempts d t) *
        Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.precision d t) ≤
    Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic (t + 1)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.scheduledExit_variation
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (hL : 7 ≤ L) (b : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.BalancedVertices r c U L)
      (entering : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)
      (hbe :
        OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.physicalAdjacent r c U L (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L) ⋯
          ↑b ↑entering)
      (t : ℕ),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
            (Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.flatExit r c U L hr hc b
              (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.precision OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t)
              entering
              (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.attempts OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t)))
          (Math115.PhysicalStarRetry.targetLaw r c U L hr hc b ⋯) ≤
        Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic (t + 1)
